Top_3_Diseases: Rice Bacterial Leaf Blight (Patti Ka Jhulsa - Xanthomonas oryzae)
Wheat Yellow / Stripe Rust (Peela Ratawa - Puccinia striiformis)
Tomato Early Blight (Agheti Jhulsa - Alternaria solani)

Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Rice_Bacterial_Blight: Leaf tips turn water-soaked -> Lesions turn yellow-white with wavy margins along veins -> Bacterial ooze droplets visible in early morning -> Leaves wilt and dry (Kresek symptom)
Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Wheat_Yellow_Rust: Small yellow chlorotic flecks appear on upper leaf -> Pustules align into parallel yellow stripes along veins -> Yellow powdery urediniospores shed on touch -> Leaves dry up prematurely
Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Tomato_Early_Blight: Dark brown necrotic spots on lower foliage -> Concentric 'target-board' rings develop -> Chlorotic yellow halos surround dark spots -> Defoliation spreads upwards

Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Rice_Bacterial_Blight: Copper Oxychloride 50% WP @ 500 g + Streptocycline @ 6 g in 200 L water per acre (CCS HAU Standard)
Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Wheat_Yellow_Rust: Propiconazole 25% EC (Tilt) @ 200 ml in 200 L water per acre at initial stripe appearance
Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Tomato_Early_Blight: Mancozeb 75% WP (Dithane M-45) @ 600-800 g or Chlorothalonil 75% WP (Kavach) @ 400 g in 200 L water per acre

Top_3_Diseases: Rice Foot Rot / Bakanae (Jhanda Rog - Fusarium fujikuroi)
Sugarcane Red Rot (Lal Sadand - Colletotrichum falcatum)
Wheat Loose Smut (Kangua Rog - Ustilago tritici)

Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Rice_Bakanae: Infected plants grow conspicuously taller and paler than healthy crop -> Adventitious roots sprout from lower nodes -> Seedlings wither and dry out before grain formation
Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Sugarcane_Red_Rot: Top 3rd and 4th leaves turn pale yellow -> Midrib develops red lesions with ash-colored centers -> Split cane shows red pith with white transverse patches -> Sour alcoholic odor
Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Wheat_Loose_Smut: Ears emerge earlier than healthy plants -> Entire spikelets converted into olive-black powdery spore mass -> Wind blows away spores leaving bare naked rachis

Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Rice_Bakanae: Seed treatment: Carbendazim 50% WP @ 2.0 g/kg seed + Streptocycline @ 0.1 g/kg seed. Seedling root dip in Carbendazim (1.0 g/L) for 6 hours before transplanting
Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Sugarcane_Red_Rot: Sett dip in Carbendazim 50% WP @ 2 g/L water for 15 mins. Soil application: Trichoderma viride @ 2.5 kg mixed with 100 kg FYM per acre
Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Wheat_Loose_Smut: Seed treatment prior to sowing: Tebuconazole 2% DS (Raxil) @ 1.0 g per kg seed or Carboxin 37.5% + Thiram 37.5% DS @ 2.5 g per kg seed

Top_3_Diseases: Potato Late Blight (Pichheti Jhulsa - Phytophthora infestans)
Rice False Smut (Jhootha Kandraog - Ustilaginoidea virens)
Wheat Karnal Bunt (Tilletia indica)

Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Potato_Late_Blight: Water-soaked dark purplish lesions on leaf margins -> White downy cottony fungal growth on underside during high humidity -> Rapid rotting of foliage with foul smell -> Brown firm dry rot on tuber skin
Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Rice_False_Smut: Individual grains in panicle swell into large velvety yellowish-green spore balls -> Spore balls turn dark olive-green to blackish-orange -> Chalky grain contamination
Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Wheat_Karnal_Bunt: Part of grain replaced by black powdery mass -> Smells like rotten fish (trimethylamine) -> Glumes spread apart exposing infected black seed tip

Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Potato_Late_Blight: Preventive: Mancozeb 75% WP @ 600-800 g/acre. Curative post-infection: Cymoxanil 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP (Curzate M-8) @ 600 g in 200-250 L water per acre
Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Rice_False_Smut: Kresoxim-methyl 44.3% SC @ 200 ml or Copper Hydroxide 53.8% DF (Kocide) @ 500 g in 200 L water per acre at booting stage
Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Wheat_Karnal_Bunt: Propiconazole 25% EC (Tilt) @ 200 ml in 200 L water per acre at 5-10% earhead emergence stage

Top_3_Diseases: Rice Sheath Blight (Tana Jhulsa - Rhizoctonia solani)
Sunflower Alternaria Leaf Blight (Alternaria helianthi)
Wheat Powdery Mildew (Chhachhiya - Blumeria graminis)

Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Rice_Sheath_Blight: Greenish-grey oval or irregular spots on leaf sheath near waterline -> Spots enlarge with dark brown borders and pale green centers -> Cobweb-like mycelial growth on stems causing lodging
Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Sunflower_Alternaria_Blight: Circular to irregular dark brown spots with concentric zones on leaves -> Spots coalesce into large necrotic patches -> Premature drying and defoliation of leaves
Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Wheat_Powdery_Mildew: White powdery fungal pustules on lower leaves and stems -> Powdery patches turn dull gray-brown with tiny black fruiting bodies (cleistothecia) -> Leaves turn chlorotic and wither

Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Rice_Sheath_Blight: Hexaconazole 5% SC (Contaf) @ 400 ml or Validamycin 3% L (Sheathmar) @ 400 ml in 200 L water directed at plant base
Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Sunflower_Alternaria_Blight: Mancozeb 75% WP @ 600-800 g in 200 L water per acre at 15-day intervals
Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Wheat_Powdery_Mildew: Wettable Sulfur 80% WDG (Sulfex) @ 1.0 kg/acre or Propiconazole 25% EC (Tilt) @ 200 ml in 200 L water per acre

Top_3_Diseases: Sugarcane Red Rot (Lal Sadand - Colletotrichum falcatum)
Rice Brown Spot (Bhoora Dhabba - Bipolaris oryzae)
Wheat Stripe / Yellow Rust (Puccinia striiformis)

Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Sugarcane_Red_Rot: Third and fourth leaves from top show marginal yellowing -> Midrib shows red longitudinal lesions with white centers -> Splitting cane reveals red pith with distinct white horizontal bands -> Sour alcoholic fermented odor
Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Rice_Brown_Spot: Small circular to oval sesame-seed shaped brown spots on leaves -> Spots develop grayish centers with reddish-brown margins -> Seedling blight and grain discolouration
Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Wheat_Stripe_Rust: Linear bright-yellow pustules on leaf surface arranged in stripes -> Yellow dust rubs off on fingers -> Foliage dries prematurely

Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Sugarcane_Red_Rot: Plant disease-free certified setts. Sett treatment: Carbendazim 50% WP (Bavistin) @ 2 g/L water dip for 15 mins. Soil application: Trichoderma viride bio-agent @ 2.5 kg mixed with 100 kg FYM per acre
Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Rice_Brown_Spot: Mancozeb 75% WP @ 600 g or Propiconazole 25% EC (Tilt) @ 200 ml in 200 L water per acre
Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Wheat_Stripe_Rust: Propiconazole 25% EC @ 200 ml or Tebuconazole 25.9% EC (Folicur) @ 200 ml in 200 L water per acre

Top_3_Diseases: Maize Northern Leaf Blight (Exserohilum turcicum)
Maize Fall Armyworm (Lashkari Soondi - Spodoptera frugiperda)
Wheat Flag Smut (Dhaja Kangua - Urocystis agropyri)

Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Maize_Northern_Blight: Long elliptical boat-shaped grayish-green lesions on leaves -> Lesions enlarge up to 15 cm and turn tan with dark borders -> Lower canopy blights and dries
Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Maize_Fall_Armyworm: Ragged shot-hole feeding on leaves in whorl -> Heavy sawdust-like fecal frass accumulation in central whorl -> Deep feeding damage on emerging tassels and ears
Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Wheat_Flag_Smut: Long grayish-black blister stripes run parallel to leaf veins -> Stripes rupture releasing black powdery teliospores -> Leaves twist, curl, and wither into ragged strips

Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Maize_Northern_Blight: Azoxystrobin 18.2% + Difenoconazole 11.4% SC (Amistar Top) @ 200 ml or Mancozeb 75% WP @ 600-800 g in 200 L water per acre
Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Maize_Fall_Armyworm: Emamectin Benzoate 5% SG (Proclaim) @ 80 g or Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC (Coragen) @ 80 ml directed into whorls using knapsack sprayer
Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Wheat_Flag_Smut: Seed treatment: Carboxin 37.5% + Thiram 37.5% DS (Vitavax Power) @ 2.5 g/kg seed or Tebuconazole 2% DS @ 1.25 g/kg seed

Top_3_Diseases: Sugarcane Smut (Kajiwa Rog - Sporisorium scitamineum)
Sugarcane Top Borer (Choti Bhedak - Scirpophaga excerptalis)
Rice Neck Blast (Gardana Rog - Magnaporthe oryzae)

Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Sugarcane_Smut: Production of prominent black whip-like unbranched structure from central spindle -> Whip covered by thin silvery membrane -> Membrane ruptures releasing billions of soot-like spores
Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Sugarcane_Top_Borer: Reddish-brown midrib streaks on third/fourth leaf -> Shot-hole punctures on unfolding leaves -> Dead heart formation -> Bunchy top appearance due to side-shoot proliferation
Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Rice_Neck_Blast: Diamond or spindle-shaped lesions with grayish centers and brown borders on leaves -> Panicle node / neck turns black and rots -> Complete panicle breakage with unfilled chaffy grains

Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Sugarcane_Smut: Rogue out infected whip canes in gunny bags and burn. Sett treatment: Triadimefon 25% WP (Bayleton) @ 1 g/L water dip for 20 mins before planting
Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Sugarcane_Top_Borer: Chlorantraniliprole 0.4% GR (Ferterra) @ 7.5 kg/acre soil application along cane rows followed by light irrigation
Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Rice_Neck_Blast: Tricyclazole 75% WP (Beam) @ 120-160 g or Isoprothiolane 40% EC (Fuji-One) @ 300 ml in 200 L water per acre at panicle emergence

Top_3_Diseases: Rice Bakanae / Foot Rot (Jhanda Rog - Fusarium fujikuroi)
Rice Bacterial Leaf Blight (BLB - Xanthomonas oryzae)
Wheat Stripe Rust (Puccinia striiformis)

Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Rice_Bakanae: Seedlings stretch out taller, thin and chlorotic in nursery or field -> Adventitious roots sprout from stem nodes above soil -> Seedlings wither and dry before flowering
Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Rice_Bacterial_Blight: Yellowish wavy drying begins at leaf tip and advances down margins -> Droplets of bacterial exudate ooze on leaf underside in morning -> Straw-colored bleached foliage
Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Wheat_Stripe_Rust: Parallel yellow powdery pustule stripes along leaf veins -> Heavy rust dust coats clothes -> Foliage desiccates

Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Rice_Bakanae: Seed treatment: Carbendazim 50% WP @ 2.0 g/kg seed + Streptocycline @ 0.1 g/kg seed. Seedling root dip in Carbendazim (1.0 g/L) for 6 hours before transplanting
Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Rice_Bacterial_Blight: Copper Oxychloride 50% WP @ 500 g + Streptocycline @ 6 g in 200 L water per acre
Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Wheat_Stripe_Rust: Propiconazole 25% EC (Tilt) @ 200 ml in 200 L water per acre at onset of symptoms

Top_3_Diseases: Pepper Bacterial Spot (Kala Kutta Rog - Xanthomonas campestris pv. vesicatoria)
Tomato Leaf Curl Virus (Patti Marod Rog - ToLCV transmitted by Whitefly)
Tomato Bacterial Wilt (Ukhta Rog - Ralstonia solanacearum)

Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Pepper_Bacterial_Spot: Small yellowish-green circular spots on leaves -> Spots turn dark brown-black with water-soaked margins -> Severe leaf shedding leaving bare stems -> Raised rough scabby pustules on fruit
Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Tomato_Leaf_Curl: Severe upward and downward curling and puckering of young leaves -> Leaves become stunted, leathery, and thick -> Node shortening causing bushy dwarf plant -> Complete fruit drop
Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Tomato_Bacterial_Wilt: Rapid wilting of green foliage without prior yellowing -> Plant wilts during midday heat and fails to recover -> Stem cut surface suspended in clean water yields milky white bacterial stream

Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Pepper_Bacterial_Spot: Copper Hydroxide 77% WP (Kocide) @ 500 g + Streptocycline @ 6 g in 200 L water per acre at 10-day intervals
Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Tomato_Leaf_Curl: Vector (Whitefly) control: Diafenthiuron 50% WP (Pegasus) @ 250 g or Pyriproxyfen 10% EC @ 400 ml in 200 L water per acre. Install yellow sticky traps (15 traps/acre)
Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Tomato_Bacterial_Wilt: Soil drenching with Copper Oxychloride 50% WP @ 3 g/L + Streptocycline @ 0.2 g/L around root zone. Biological prevention: Trichoderma harzianum @ 2.5 kg/acre in vermicompost

Top_3_Diseases: Rice False Smut (Ustilaginoidea virens)
Sugarcane Early Shoot Borer (Chilo infuscatellus)
Wheat Yellow Rust (Puccinia striiformis)

Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Rice_False_Smut: Grain transforms into orange velvety spore ball -> Ball enlarges and turns olive-black powdery -> Panicle discolored
Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Sugarcane_Early_Borer: Central shoot dies forming 'dead heart' in young shoots -> Emits unpleasant smell when pulled -> Pinholes at base
Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Wheat_Yellow_Rust: Stripe-like yellow pustules on leaf blade -> Yellow powder rubs onto cloth/hands -> Desiccation

Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Rice_False_Smut: Copper Hydroxide 53.8% DF (Kocide) @ 500 g in 200 L water per acre at panicle emergence
Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Sugarcane_Early_Borer: Fipronil 0.3% GR (Regent) @ 10 kg/acre soil application at planting or Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC @ 150 ml/acre drench
Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Wheat_Yellow_Rust: Propiconazole 25% EC (Tilt) @ 200 ml in 200 L water per acre

Top_3_Diseases: Sugarcane Top Borer (Scirpophaga excerptalis)
Rice Stem Rot (Tana Galan - Sclerotium oryzae)
Wheat Flag Smut (Dhaja Kangua - Urocystis agropyri)

Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Sugarcane_Top_Borer: Reddish-brown midrib streaks on third/fourth leaf -> Shot-hole punctures on unfolding leaves -> Dead heart formation -> Bunchy top appearance due to side-shoot proliferation
Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Rice_Stem_Rot: Dark shiny lesions on leaf sheath at water surface -> Sheath rots through and stem hollows -> Lodging of plants with tiny mustard-seed like black sclerotia inside stem cavity
Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Wheat_Flag_Smut: Long grayish-black blister stripes run parallel to leaf veins -> Stripes rupture releasing black powdery teliospores -> Leaves twist, curl, and wither into ragged strips

Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Sugarcane_Top_Borer: Chlorantraniliprole 0.4% GR (Ferterra) @ 7.5 kg/acre soil application along cane rows followed by light irrigation
Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Rice_Stem_Rot: Carbendazim 50% WP @ 250 g or Thifluzamide 24% SC (Pulsor) @ 150 ml in 200 L water per acre at waterline
Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Wheat_Flag_Smut: Seed treatment: Carboxin 37.5% + Thiram 37.5% DS (Vitavax Power) @ 2.5 g/kg seed or Tebuconazole 2% DS @ 1.25 g/kg seed

Top_3_Diseases: Mustard White Rust (Safed Ratawa - Albugo candida)
Wheat Stripe Rust (Peela Ratawa - Puccinia striiformis)
Mustard Alternaria Blight (Bhoora Dhabba - Alternaria brassicae)

Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Mustard_White_Rust: Prominent creamy white raised blisters on lower leaf surface -> Blisters coalesce -> Inflorescence hyper-trophy with floral parts transformed into swollen 'staghead' structure
Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Wheat_Stripe_Rust: Small yellow pustules form narrow stripes between veins -> Leaves dry up prematurely -> Grains shrivel
Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Mustard_Alternaria_Blight: Small circular brown-black necrotic spots on leaves, stems and pods -> Concentric target-board rings on pods -> Premature pod shattering and seed discolouration

Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Mustard_White_Rust: Metalaxyl 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP (Ridomil Gold) @ 500-600 g in 200 L water per acre at initial white blister stage
Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Wheat_Stripe_Rust: Propiconazole 25% EC (Tilt) @ 200 ml in 200 L water per acre
Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Mustard_Alternaria_Blight: Mancozeb 75% WP (Dithane M-45) @ 600-800 g or Iprodione 50% WP (Rovral) @ 400 g in 200 L water per acre

Top_3_Diseases: Tomato Late Blight (Pichheti Jhulsa - Phytophthora infestans)
Bajra Downy Mildew / Green Ear (Kodia Rog - Sclerospora graminicola)
Wheat Termites / White Ants (Deemak - Odontotermes obesus)

Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Tomato_Late_Blight: Water-soaked dark purplish lesions on foliage -> White downy mold on underside in wet weather -> Rapid fruit browning with firm leathery decay
Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Bajra_Green_Ear: Chlorosis on young leaves forming vivid bleached white streaks -> Downy white fungal coating on leaf underside -> Floral earheads converted into twisted green leafy structures ('green ear')
Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Wheat_Termites: Plants wither in patches across sandy soil -> Easily pull out of soil -> Roots and lower stem completely hollowed and devoured with soil filling

Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Tomato_Late_Blight: Cymoxanil 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP (Curzate M-8) @ 600 g or Dimethomorph 50% WP (Acrobat) @ 300 g in 200 L water per acre
Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Bajra_Green_Ear: Seed treatment: Metalaxyl 35% WS (Apron) @ 6.0 g/kg seed. Foliar spray: Metalaxyl-M 4% + Mancozeb 64% WP @ 500 g/acre if symptoms appear in vegetative stage
Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Wheat_Termites: Seed treatment: Chlorpyrifos 20% EC @ 4 ml/kg seed. Standing crop irrigation drench: Fipronil 5% SC @ 800 ml or Chlorpyrifos 20% EC @ 1.2 L with canal irrigation per acre

Top_3_Diseases: Cotton Whitefly & Leaf Curl Virus (CLCuV)
Rice Stem Borer (Tana Bhedak - Scirpophaga incertulas)
Wheat Yellow Rust (Puccinia striiformis)

Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Cotton_Leaf_Curl: Upward curling and thickening of leaf margins -> Enation (small leaf-like outgrowth) on underside of main veins -> Plant stunted with reduced boll setting
Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Rice_Stem_Borer: Dead central vegetative tiller in seedling stage ('dead heart') -> White empty chaffy panicle at reproductive stage ('white earhead') -> Stem shows caterpillar entry bore hole near base
Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Wheat_Yellow_Rust: Parallel yellow stripes of pustules along veins -> Powder sheds on touch -> Premature maturity

Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Cotton_Leaf_Curl: Whitefly vector suppression: Pyriproxyfen 10% EC @ 400 ml or Diafenthiuron 50% WP @ 250 g in 200 L water per acre. Rogue out early infected viral plants
Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Rice_Stem_Borer: Cartap Hydrochloride 4% GR (Padan) @ 7.5 kg/acre or Chlorantraniliprole 0.4% GR (Ferterra) @ 4 kg/acre in standing water
Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Wheat_Yellow_Rust: Propiconazole 25% EC (Tilt) @ 200 ml in 200 L water per acre

Top_3_Diseases: Cotton Leaf Curl Virus (Patti Marod Rog - CLCuV via Bemisia tabaci)
Cotton Pink Bollworm (Gulabi Soondi - Pectinophora gossypiella)
Guar Bacterial Blight (Bacterial Mar - Xanthomonas cyamopsidis)

Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Cotton_CLCuV: Small veins thicken and turn dark green -> Upward curling of leaf margins -> Leaf-like outgrowths (enations) develop beneath veins -> Extreme plant stunting
Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Cotton_Pink_Bollworm: Rosetted flowers that fail to open properly -> Young developing bolls show tiny brown entry holes -> Bolls open prematurely with stained lint and destroyed seeds
Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Guar_Bacterial_Blight: Water-soaked dark angular spots on leaf lamina -> Black longitudinal streaks on stems -> Petioles rot and collapse causing rapid defoliation

Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Cotton_CLCuV: Vector Whitefly control: Flonicamid 50% WG (Ulala) @ 80 g or Afidopyropen 50 g/L DC (Sefina) @ 400 ml in 200 L water per acre
Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Cotton_Pink_Bollworm: Pheromone traps @ 8/acre for monitoring. Spray: Emamectin Benzoate 5% SG @ 100 g or Spinetoram 11.7% SC @ 170 ml in 200 L water per acre at ETL (>8 moths/trap/night)
Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Guar_Bacterial_Blight: Seed treatment: Streptocycline @ 0.25 g/kg seed. Standing crop spray: Copper Oxychloride 50% WP @ 500 g + Streptocycline @ 6 g in 200 L water per acre

Top_3_Diseases: Cotton Para Wilt / Sudden Wilt (Akasmat Ukhta)
Mustard Aphids (Mahu / Chepa - Lipaphis erysimi)
Wheat Brown / Leaf Rust (Puccinia triticina)

Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Cotton_Para_Wilt: Sudden drooping of entire foliage within 24-48 hours after heavy rain or canal irrigation -> Leaves wilt while still green -> Root system intact but water transport blocked
Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Mustard_Aphids: Dense colonies of tiny green-yellow insects clustering on tender apical twigs, flowers, and pods -> Insects suck sap causing yellowing and curling -> Plants covered in sticky shiny honeydew and black sooty mold
Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Wheat_Brown_Rust: Small round to oval orange-brown pustules scattered randomly across upper leaf blade -> Pustules do not form stripes -> Leaves turn yellow and dry

Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Cotton_Para_Wilt: Drain excess water immediately. Foliar spray: Cobalt Chloride @ 10 ppm (10 mg/L) or 1% Urea + 1% Potassium Nitrate (13-0-45) foliar spray immediately upon symptom onset
Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Mustard_Aphids: Thiamethoxam 25% WG (Actara) @ 50-80 g or Dimethoate 30% EC (Rogor) @ 250-300 ml in 200 L water per acre when aphid index exceeds 1.5-2.0 cm twig colony
Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Wheat_Brown_Rust: Propiconazole 25% EC (Tilt) @ 200 ml in 200 L water per acre at onset of orange-brown pustules

Top_3_Diseases: Cotton Whitefly & CLCuV (Bemisia tabaci)
Cotton Pink Bollworm (Pectinophora gossypiella)
Mustard White Rust (Albugo candida)

Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Cotton_Whitefly_CLCuV: Leaves curl upwards -> Vein thickening on underside -> Foliar enations develop -> Sticky honey-dew with sooty mold
Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Cotton_Pink_Bollworm: Rosetted flowers -> Larvae bore into tender bolls -> Damaged lint and stained locules
Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Mustard_White_Rust: White pustules beneath leaf surface -> Hypertrophy and malformation of floral parts

Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Cotton_Whitefly_CLCuV: Flonicamid 50% WG (Ulala) @ 80 g or Pyriproxyfen 10% EC @ 400 ml in 200 L water per acre
Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Cotton_Pink_Bollworm: Emamectin Benzoate 5% SG @ 100 g or Spinetoram 11.7% SC @ 170 ml in 200 L water per acre
Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Mustard_White_Rust: Metalaxyl 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP (Ridomil Gold) @ 500 g in 200 L water per acre

Top_3_Diseases: Rice Brown Plant Hopper (BPH / Tela - Nilaparvata lugens)
Cotton Bacterial Blight / Black Arm (Xanthomonas malvacearum)
Wheat Stripe Rust (Peela Ratawa - Puccinia striiformis)

Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Rice_BPH: Circular patches of plants dry up rapidly taking a scorched burned appearance ('hopper burn') -> Hoppers congregate at the base of hill just above water level -> Plant collapses
Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Cotton_Bacterial_Blight: Angular water-soaked spots bounded by leaf veins on foliage -> Spots turn blackish-brown -> Elongated black lesions on stems ('black arm') -> Premature boll rotting
Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Wheat_Stripe_Rust: Yellow spore pustules aligned in linear rows on upper leaf blade -> Chlorosis and premature desiccation

Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Rice_BPH: Pymetrozine 50% WG (Chess) @ 120 g or Triflemezopyrim 10% SC (Pexalon) @ 94 ml in 200 L water directed at base of plants
Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Cotton_Bacterial_Blight: Copper Oxychloride 50% WP @ 500 g + Streptocycline @ 6 g in 200 L water per acre at initial spot appearance
Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Wheat_Stripe_Rust: Propiconazole 25% EC (Tilt) @ 200 ml in 200 L water per acre

Top_3_Diseases: Cotton Whitefly (Safed Makhi - Bemisia tabaci)
Mustard Sclerotinia Stem Rot (Tana Galan - Sclerotinia sclerotiorum)
Wheat Loose Smut (Kangua - Ustilago tritici)

Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Cotton_Whitefly: Tiny white winged insects flutter in clouds when plant is shaken -> Chlorotic yellow spots on leaves -> Honeydew secretions turn foliage black with sooty mold -> Spreads leaf curl virus
Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Mustard_Sclerotinia_Rot: Elongated grayish-white bleached lesions on stem base -> Stems become chalky, fragile, and shred easily -> Splitting stem reveals hard black rat-dropping like sclerotial bodies
Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Wheat_Loose_Smut: Emerging ears completely transformed into black powdery smut dust -> Naked stem left behind

Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Cotton_Whitefly: Diafenthiuron 50% WP @ 250 g or Pyriproxyfen 10% EC @ 400 ml or Dinotefuran 20% SG (Token) @ 60-80 g in 200 L water per acre
Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Mustard_Sclerotinia_Rot: Carbendazim 50% WP (Bavistin) @ 250 g or Thiophanate Methyl 70% WP (Roko) @ 400 g in 200 L water per acre sprayed at stem base at 50-60 days crop age
Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Wheat_Loose_Smut: Seed treatment: Tebuconazole 2% DS (Raxil) @ 1.0 g per kg seed prior to sowing

Top_3_Diseases: Chickpea Wilt (Chana Ukhta - Fusarium oxysporum f. sp. ciceris)
Chickpea Pod Borer (Lassan Soondi - Helicoverpa armigera)
Guar Alternaria Leaf Spot (Alternaria cyamopsidis)

Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Chickpea_Wilt: Sudden drooping of petioles and leaves within 2-3 weeks of sowing or flowering -> Leaves retain dull green color before drying -> Internal xylem vascular tissues show dark brown discoloration upon splitting tap root
Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Chickpea_Pod_Borer: Young larvae feed on tender foliage -> Older caterpillars bore circular holes into developing pods, thrusting anterior half of body inside to devour seeds -> Empty hollow pods
Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Guar_Alternaria_Spot: Dark brown circular spots with concentric rings on leaf blade -> Severe defoliation under warm humid weather

Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Chickpea_Wilt: Deep summer plowing. Seed treatment: Trichoderma viride @ 4 g/kg seed + Carbendazim @ 1 g/kg seed. Avoid sowing in infected soil for 3 seasons
Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Chickpea_Pod_Borer: Install 'T' shaped bird perches @ 15/acre and pheromone traps @ 5/acre. Spray: Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC (Coragen) @ 60 ml or Emamectin Benzoate 5% SG @ 80 g in 200 L water per acre
Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Guar_Alternaria_Spot: Mancozeb 75% WP @ 600-800 g in 200 L water per acre at first symptom appearance

Top_3_Diseases: Bajra Blast (Dhabba Rog - Pyricularia grisea)
Bajra Ergot (Gondia Rog - Claviceps fusiformis)
Mustard Downy Mildew (Tulaasita - Hyaloperonospora brassicae)

Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Bajra_Blast: Diamond or spindle-shaped gray-centered necrotic spots on leaves -> Spots coalesce burning large foliage areas -> Poor panicle development
Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Bajra_Ergot: Pinkish honey-like viscous droplet exudation ('honeydew') from infected florets in earhead -> Droplets dry into hard dark brown/black horn-shaped sclerotial bodies protruding from spikelets -> Toxic to livestock
Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Mustard_Downy_Mildew: Yellow angular chlorotic patches on upper leaf surface -> Downy grayish-white fungal growth on lower surface -> Leaves curl, wither and drop

Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Bajra_Blast: Zineb 75% WP @ 600 g or Tricyclazole 75% WP @ 120 g in 200 L water per acre
Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Bajra_Ergot: Steep seed in 10% salt brine solution (float off sclerotia) followed by 2 clean water rinses. Spray: Mancozeb 75% WP @ 600 g/acre at boot emergence
Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Mustard_Downy_Mildew: Metalaxyl 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP (Ridomil Gold) @ 500 g in 200 L water per acre

Top_3_Diseases: Mustard Painted Bug (Chitkabri Kidi - Bagrada hilaris)
Bajra Downy Mildew (Green Ear - Sclerospora graminicola)
Mustard White Rust (Albugo candida)

Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Mustard_Painted_Bug: Small shield-shaped black bugs with bright yellow/orange markings attack young seedlings -> Suck sap causing wilting and bleaching -> Seedling dries and dies completely
Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Bajra_Downy_Mildew: Chlorotic white-yellow leaf streaks -> Leaf underside covered in white down -> Earhead turns into leafy bunch
Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Mustard_White_Rust: White raised blisters on leaf underside -> Swollen distorted flower heads ('staghead')

Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Mustard_Painted_Bug: Malathion 5% dust @ 10 kg/acre dusted on seedlings in early morning or Dimethoate 30% EC (Rogor) @ 250 ml in 200 L water per acre
Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Bajra_Downy_Mildew: Seed treatment: Metalaxyl 35% WS @ 6 g/kg seed prior to sowing
Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Mustard_White_Rust: Metalaxyl 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP @ 500 g in 200 L water per acre

Top_3_Diseases: Mustard Aphid (Mahu / Chepa - Lipaphis erysimi)
Mustard Orobanche Root Parasite (Gulli Danda / Margoja - Orobanche aegyptiaca)
Chickpea Ascochyta Blight (Ascochyta rabiei)

Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Mustard_Aphid: Billions of tiny yellow-green sap-sucking insects mass on flowering tips and pods -> Plant stunting, leaf curling, pod distortion -> Sooty mold covers plants
Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Mustard_Orobanche: Fleshy purple-brown parasitic flowering shoots emerge around mustard base -> Attached directly to mustard root system -> Mustard turns yellow, wilts, and yields crash
Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Chickpea_Ascochyta: Small circular brown spots with distinct concentric rings on leaves and pods -> Spots coalesce forming dark sunken stem cankers -> Stems break at canker points causing crop lodging

Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Mustard_Aphid: Thiamethoxam 25% WG (Actara) @ 50-80 g or Dimethoate 30% EC @ 250 ml in 200 L water per acre. Spray during evening hours to protect pollinators
Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Mustard_Orobanche: Crop rotation with non-hosts (wheat/barley). Directed post-emergence spray: Glyphosate 41% SL @ 25-30 ml/acre in 200 L water at 30 & 50-55 DAS using flood-jet nozzle (HAU standard)
Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Chickpea_Ascochyta: Seed treatment: Carbendazim 12% + Mancozeb 63% WP (SAAF) @ 2.5 g/kg seed. Foliar spray: Chlorothalonil 75% WP @ 400 g in 200 L water per acre

Top_3_Diseases: Mustard White Rust & Staghead (Albugo candida)
Mustard Powdery Mildew (Erysiphe cruciferarum)
Wheat Termites (Odontotermes obesus)

Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Mustard_White_Rust: Chalky white blisters beneath leaves -> Inflorescences swell into thick twisted sterile green spires ('staghead')
Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Mustard_Powdery_Mildew: White talcum-powder like dusting spreads across upper leaf surface, stems, and siliquae -> Foliage chlorosis and early drying
Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Wheat_Termites: Wilted seedlings pull out easily from sandy fields -> Roots hollowed and filled with dry mud particles

Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Mustard_White_Rust: Metalaxyl 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP (Ridomil Gold) @ 500 g in 200 L water per acre
Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Mustard_Powdery_Mildew: Wettable Sulfur 80% WDG @ 1.0 kg/acre or Dinocap 48% EC (Karathane) @ 150 ml in 200 L water per acre
Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Wheat_Termites: Seed treatment: Fipronil 5% SC @ 5 ml/kg seed or Chlorpyrifos 20% EC @ 4 ml/kg seed before sowing

Top_3_Diseases: Onion Purple Blotch (Baingani Dhabba - Alternaria porri)
Mustard Aphids (Mahu - Lipaphis erysimi)
Onion Thrips (Pili Kidi - Thrips tabaci)

Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Onion_Purple_Blotch: Small water-soaked sunken lesions on leaves -> Lesions turn purplish with yellow borders -> Lesions girdle leaves causing stem collapse
Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Mustard_Aphids: Dense colonies suck sap from flowering shoots -> Heavy honeydew and sooty mold -> Yield reduction
Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Onion_Thrips: Minute silvery-white specks and blotches on leaves -> Leaf tips curl and turn brown ('white blast') -> Severe bulb size reduction

Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Onion_Purple_Blotch: Mancozeb 75% WP @ 600 g or Difenoconazole 25% EC (Score) @ 150 ml in 200 L water per acre with 50 ml sticker
Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Mustard_Aphids: Thiamethoxam 25% WG (Actara) @ 60 g in 200 L water per acre
Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Onion_Thrips: Fipronil 5% SC (Regent) @ 400 ml or Spinetoram 11.7% SC @ 150 ml in 200 L water per acre with agricultural sticker

Primary_Crops: Tamatar & Pyaj / Tomato & Onion (Solanum lycopersicum & Allium cepa)
Top_3_Diseases: Mustard Alternaria Blight (Alternaria brassicae)
Bajra Green Ear / Downy Mildew (Sclerospora graminicola)
Tomato Leaf Curl Virus (ToLCV via Whitefly)

Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Mustard_Alternaria_Blight: Concentric target-board brown circular spots on leaves -> Black lesions on siliquae (pods) -> Premature pod shattering
Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Bajra_Green_Ear: Chlorotic streaks on upper leaves -> Floral parts transform into leafy twisted masses -> No grain formation
Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Tomato_Leaf_Curl: Leaves curl inwards and upwards -> Severe stunting and bushy stunted growth -> Failure of flower setting

Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Mustard_Alternaria_Blight: Mancozeb 75% WP @ 600-800 g or Iprodione 50% WP (Rovral) @ 400 g in 200 L water per acre
Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Bajra_Green_Ear: Seed treatment with Metalaxyl 35% WS @ 6 g/kg seed; rogue out infected downy mildew plants
Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Tomato_Leaf_Curl: Vector whitefly spray: Diafenthiuron 50% WP (Pegasus) @ 250 g or Cyantraniliprole 10.26% OD @ 360 ml per acre

Top_3_Diseases: Potato Early Blight (Alternaria solani)
Potato Black Scurf (Rhizoctonia solani)
Wheat Stripe Rust (Puccinia striiformis)

Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Potato_Early_Blight: Concentric dark brown target rings on lower foliage -> Leaves turn yellow around spots -> Defoliation
Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Potato_Black_Scurf: Hard dark brown to black crusty dirt-like sclerotia adhering tightly to tuber surface (does not wash off) -> Stem cankers near ground level
Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Wheat_Stripe_Rust: Bright yellow pustule stripes along leaf blade -> Chlorosis and shrivelled grain

Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Potato_Early_Blight: Mancozeb 75% WP @ 600-800 g or Chlorothalonil 75% WP @ 400 g in 200 L water per acre
Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Potato_Black_Scurf: Tuber treatment before cold storage/planting: Moncut 20% SC (Flutolanil) @ 2.5 ml/L water spray or Carbendazim 50% WP @ 2.5 g/L dip for 10 mins
Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Wheat_Stripe_Rust: Propiconazole 25% EC (Tilt) @ 200 ml in 200 L water per acre

Primary_Crops: Tamatar & Gobhi / Tomato & Cauliflower (Solanum lycopersicum & Brassica oleracea)
Top_3_Diseases: Cauliflower Black Rot (Kali Sadand - Xanthomonas campestris)
Tomato Leaf Curl Virus (ToLCV)
Mustard Alternaria Leaf Spot (Alternaria brassicae)

Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Cauliflower_Black_Rot: Yellow V-shaped chlorotic lesions starting at leaf margins with point toward vein -> Veins turn black within lesion -> Soft rotting of curd head with offensive odor
Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Tomato_Leaf_Curl: Leaves puckered, curled upward, stunted and leathery -> Severely dwarfed bush
Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Mustard_Alternaria: Concentric circular brown spots on leaves and pods -> Premature pod shattering

Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Cauliflower_Black_Rot: Seed treatment: Hot water treatment at 50°C for 30 mins or Streptocycline @ 0.1 g/L dip. Foliar spray: Copper Oxychloride 50% WP @ 500 g + Streptocycline @ 6 g in 200 L water per acre
Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Tomato_Leaf_Curl: Vector whitefly control: Diafenthiuron 50% WP @ 250 g in 200 L water per acre
Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Mustard_Alternaria: Mancozeb 75% WP @ 600-800 g in 200 L water per acre

Top_3_Diseases: Mustard White Rust (Albugo candida)
Bajra Downy Mildew / Green Ear (Sclerospora graminicola)
Wheat Loose Smut (Ustilago tritici)

Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Mustard_White_Rust: White pustules beneath leaves -> Inflorescences distorted into stagheads
Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Bajra_Green_Ear: Bleached leaf stripes -> White mold on leaf underside -> Earhead transforms into leafy mass
Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Wheat_Loose_Smut: Spike emerges early -> Grains replaced by loose black soot

Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Mustard_White_Rust: Metalaxyl 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP @ 500 g in 200 L water per acre
Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Bajra_Green_Ear: Seed treatment: Metalaxyl 35% WS @ 6.0 g/kg seed
Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Wheat_Loose_Smut: Seed treatment: Tebuconazole 2% DS @ 1.0 g per kg seed prior to sowing

Top_3_Diseases: Mango Malformation (Aam Ka Guchha Rog - Fusarium mangiferae)
Mango Powdery Mildew (Kojhi Rog - Oidium mangiferae)
Maize Northern Leaf Blight (Exserohilum turcicum)

Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Mango_Malformation: Floral panicles transform into compact, crowded, bunchy heads of sterile flowers -> Flower stalks thicken and crowd -> No fruit setting
Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Mango_Powdery_Mildew: White powdery fungal coating on flower buds, panicles, and young leaves -> Infected flowers fail to open and drop off -> Young marble-sized fruits drop prematurely
Symptom_Checklist_Offline.Maize_Northern_Blight: Long elliptical tan lesions on lower leaves -> Upward spreading blight

Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Mango_Malformation: Prune out malformed panicles along with 3 nodes of healthy branch and burn. Spray NAA (Planofix) @ 200 ppm (2 ml/4.5 L water) in first week of October (HAU recommendation)
Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Mango_Powdery_Mildew: Wettable Sulfur 80% WDG @ 1.25 kg in 500 L water or Hexaconazole 5% SC @ 500 ml in 500 L water per acre (applied at panicle emergence)
Approved_Pesticide_Solution.Maize_Northern_Blight: Azoxystrobin 18.2% + Difenoconazole 11.4% SC @ 200 ml in 200 L water per acre
